target.statement: Outlier detection on GeneticSequences: the two series with highest outlier scores (sum of distances based on total correlation and marginal probabilities) are identified as outliers, as shown in the boxplot.
target.table_ref: Figure 7 (boxplot of outlier scores) and the preceding code block; no table number, but the result is the identification of two anomalous genetic sequences.

compute.basis: The target is a simple R script using the ctsfeatures package on 32 short DNA sequences; all computations are trivial and run in seconds on a CPU.

title: Analyzing categorical time series with the R package ctsfeatures
